### 2. Create the Windshield Cutout

### 3. Create the Wheels
- Create four cylinders, each with radius 25 and height 10
- Orient the cylinders so their axis runs along the width of the car (Y-axis)
- Position each wheel at the bottom corners of the car body

### 4. Combine All Elements
- Union the main body (after windshield subtraction) with all four wheels
